newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-N.TVL BEAT GRIQUAS IN CUP QUARTER-FINAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-N.TVL BEAT GRIQUAS IN CUP QUARTER-FINAL.

text.p: A fluent 109 from opener Mike Rindel in difficult conditions steered Northern Transvaal to a crushing victory by 123 runs over Griqualand West in their Standard Bank Cup quarter-final replay at Kimberley Country Club on Friday night.
Batting first on a pitch of uneven bounce, Northerns made a testing 233 for five in their allotted 45 overs with subsequent man of the match Rindel hitting 109 from 132 balls.
Rindel and Roy Pienaar (47) launched the innings in style with a first-wicket stand of 98 in 18 overs while left-arm seamer Adri Swanepoel was the pick of the Griquas attack with 3-43.
Fast bowler Rudi Bryson then took career-best figures of 4-17 as Griquas were routed for a lowly 110 in 35 overs.
Yet Griquas had to recover after being rocked by a hostile opening spell from Bryson who took 3-8 in his first five overs.
Steve Elworthy weighed in with 3-22 in an unbroken nine-over spell and the home side were reduced to 33 for seven before Ralph Koster gave them some respectability with a gutsy 59.

Koster struck three sixes and four fours as he shared in an eighth-wicket stand of 72 with debutant all-rounder Andre Botha, who made 17. The pair ensured that the home side at least reached the three-figure mark.
With their one-sided win, Northerns advance to a home semi-final tie against Western Province on April 20.
Bowling: Elworthy 9-2-22-3, Bryson 7-1-17-4, de Villiers 6-1-19-0, van Zyl 7-2-22-1, Davis 6-0-29-2.
Result: Northern Transvaal won by 123 runs.
Man of the match: Mike Rindel.
